props.name: label
props.description: This peer's name, shown in the header and on its messages.

props.name: signalling
props.description: Copy/paste the SDP by hand, or exchange it with other tabs and panels over a BroadcastChannel.

props.name: channel
props.description: BroadcastChannel name for `broadcast` signalling. Peers on the same name find each other.

props.name: iceServers
props.description: STUN/TURN servers. Empty by default, which is enough on one machine or one network — and works offline.

props.name: chunkSize
props.description: File chunk size in bytes. 16 KB is the size every browser delivers unsplit.

props.name: onMessage
props.description: Called with each text message the other peer sends.
